implementations.discount: if price >= 0 && bps >= 0 && bps <= 10000 then (price * 10000 - price * bps) / 10000 else -1
implementations.add_tax: if price >= 0 && bps >= 0 && bps <= 10000 then (price * 10000 + price * bps + 9999) / 10000 else -1
implementations.prorate: if total > 0 && amount >= 0 && used >= 0 && total >= used then used * amount / total else -1
implementations.ceil_div: if size > 0 && amount >= 0 then (size - 1 + amount) / size else -1
implementations.clamp: if lower >= 0 && lower <= upper then (if value > upper then upper else if value < lower then lower else value) else -1
implementations.saturating_sub: if debit >= 0 && balance >= 0 then (if balance >= debit then balance - debit else 0) else -1
implementations.transfer_remaining: if amount >= 0 && amount <= balance then balance + (0 - amount) else -1

implementations.loyalty_points: if unit > 0 && spend >= 0 then (spend + 0) / unit else -1
implementations.tier_rate: if high >= 0 && low >= 0 && threshold >= 0 && quantity >= 0 then (if quantity < threshold then low else high) else -1

implementations.refund_cap: if paid >= 0 && requested >= 0 then (if paid <= requested then paid else requested) else -1
implementations.inventory_available: if reserved >= 0 && reserved <= stock then stock + (0 - reserved) else -1
implementations.reorder_quantity: if target >= 0 && available >= 0 then (if available >= target then 0 else target - available) else -1
implementations.interval_overlap: if a_start >= 0 && a_end >= a_start && b_start >= 0 && b_end >= b_start then (if (if a_start < b_start then b_start else a_start) >= (if a_end > b_end then b_end else a_end) then 0 else (if a_end > b_end then b_end else a_end) - (if a_start < b_start then b_start else a_start)) else -1
implementations.within_window: if start >= 0 && end >= start then (if value < start || value >= end then 0 else 1) else -1
implementations.leap_year: if year > 0 then (if year % 400 == 0 then 1 else if year % 100 == 0 then 0 else if year % 4 == 0 then 1 else 0) else -1
implementations.days_in_month: if year > 0 && month >= 1 && month <= 12 then (if month == 4 || month == 6 || month == 9 || month == 11 then 30 else if month != 2 then 31 else if year % 400 == 0 then 29 else if year % 100 == 0 then 28 else if year % 4 == 0 then 29 else 28) else -1

implementations.median_of_three: if c >= 0 && b >= 0 && a >= 0 then (if b <= a then (if a <= c then a else if b <= c then c else b) else (if b <= c then b else if a <= c then c else a)) else -1
